summary: Kesari Cleaning Services will clean Tulsi Tiffin House's kitchen and dining area in Pune every night after closing, using its own materials and equipment. The agreement starts on 1 December 2026 and runs for two years. It renews by itself for another two years unless Tulsi Tiffin House gives written notice at least ninety days before the term ends. The fee is Rs. 18,000 a month plus GST, and Kesari can raise it by up to 10% at each renewal. Each monthly invoice is due within seven days, and late amounts carry interest of 2% a month. Ending the agreement early means paying the monthly fee for every month left in the term. Kesari's liability is capped at one month's fee, while Tulsi Tiffin House covers Kesari against all claims arising from the condition of its premises. Indian law applies, and only the courts at Pune can hear disputes.
